svg.title: Metrics Tree Hierarchical Diagram
svg.desc: Top-down tree diagram showing the AIL metrics hierarchy. The North Star Metric (AI-Augmented Development Throughput) branches into four zone-level metric groups, each with leading and lagging indicators. A parallel counter-metrics branch shows six gaming-prevention metrics. Evidence-level badges mark each metric as Validated, Emerging, Expert judgment, or Speculative.
svg.text: From North Star through zones to individual indicators, with evidence levels
Most targets are expert judgment or speculative. This is expected at AIL's current validation stage.
Leading indicators predict. Lagging indicators confirm. Counter-metrics prevent gaming.
Report distributions, not averages. Apply thresholds at team level, not organizational average.
